title: Remove a value
prompt: The robot drops one copy of an item. remove_value gives back the array without the first copy of value; if there is none, the array is unchanged. [1, 2, 3, 2] minus 2 is [1, 3, 2].

tests.name: Removing the only item leaves empty

hints: erase removes by value; remove_at removes by position.

docs.name: list.erase(value)
docs.what: Removes the first copy of value. Returns nothing.
